protocol.grid_equivalence: exact frozen coordinates and weights from the same reference fixture
protocol.execution: sequential fresh processes, pinned physical cores; cyclic reference/candidate order; no SCF in timed process
protocol.reference: Cumulative stage 07-potential; one frozen SCF fixture generated from 00-base
protocol.candidate: Cumulative potential, cache-block and compact-response stages
protocol.fixture: one converged SCF from upstream reference per system, then reused unchanged for all branches and repetitions

solver.type: cphf.solve or ucphf.solve with zero overlap response

protocol.time: cache construction plus full CPKS solve including conventional Coulomb response; cache and solver also reported separately
protocol.exclusions: imports, input load, SCF, dipole-integral construction, postsolve residual check; excluded from response wall time only
protocol.memory: sample VmRSS every 5 ms throughout cache plus solve, report absolute peak and baseline increment; process ru_maxrss is diagnostic and includes startup
protocol.summary: statistics.median over three process runs; report minimum and maximum; disclose regressions and full-source provenance
protocol.api_policy: No monkeypatching or changes to NumInt/response callbacks. Wrapping the returned linear action only counts solver calls. Cache type is read from closure metadata after timing.

order: sequential fresh processes, version order rotated by replicate
